title: A Pathway to General-Purpose Scientific AI: Multimodal Comprehension of Scientific Images
abstract: arXiv:2608.14075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific figures and tables encode essential experimental evidence, yet remain difficult for digital libraries and multimodal AI systems to retrieve and interpret. The ALD/E-ImageMiner benchmark and ICDAR 2026 Competition on Information Extraction from Atomic Layer Deposition/Etching Scientific Figures provide 1,951 figures from 205 publications, expert-annotated for classification, data table extraction, summarization, and visual question answering. In these companion proceedings, we present a forward-looking perspective on how the benchmark can guide future scientific-image challenges. We examine how its tasks probe capabilities from visual and quantitative reading to domain-grounded reasoning and evidential justification, and how Bloom-informed question design can support deeper scientific understanding. We propose "scientific conceptual understanding from images" as a long-term benchmark objective, with future directions including

translated_title: 通往通用科学人工智能的路径：科学图像的多模态理解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14075v1 公告类型：新 摘要：科学图表和表格编码了关键的实验证据，但数字图书馆和多模态人工智能系统在检索和解释这些内容方面仍面临困难。ALD/E-ImageMiner基准测试和ICDAR 2026原子层沉积/蚀刻科学图表信息提取竞赛提供了来自205篇出版物的1,951张图表，经过专家标注，用于分类、数据表提取、摘要生成和视觉问答。在这些配套会议录中，我们提出了一个前瞻性视角，探讨该基准如何指导未来的科学图像挑战。我们考察了其任务如何探测从视觉和定量阅读到领域基础推理和证据论证的能力，以及基于Bloom（布鲁姆）分类法的问题设计如何支持更深入的科学理解。我们提出“从图像中进行科学概念理解”作为长期基准目标，未来方向包括……
tldr: 本文通过引入ALD/E-ImageMiner基准和ICDAR 2026竞赛，提出了一种以“从图像理解科学概念”为核心目标的通用科学AI发展路径，强调多模态理解、领域推理和证据论证的整合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a pathway to general-purpose scientific AI via the ALD/E-ImageMiner benchmark and ICDAR 2026 competition, centering on "scientific conceptual understanding from images" to integrate multimodal comprehension, domain reasoning, and evidential justification.
